## Summary

Describe the change and the contribution lane it belongs to.

## Contribution Lane

- [ ] Standard / docs
- [ ] Runtime package
- [ ] Conformance / evidence
- [ ] Adapter
- [ ] Reference service
- [ ] Agentic UI
- [ ] Community operations

## HKI Safety

- [ ] No new null, `global`, wildcard, or implicit fallback runtime scope
- [ ] Cross-domain behavior uses explicit publication or admin-plane paths
- [ ] Retrieval, memory, cache, tools, jobs, traces, and evals remain domain-bound where touched
- [ ] Negative or fail-closed behavior is covered when the change touches runtime boundaries

## Docs And Release Notes

- [ ] Docs updated or not needed
- [ ] Env vars, ports, migrations, feature flags, or rollout order called out
- [ ] Public API/package compatibility considered
